Senior Backend Engineer - Fabrikam Cloud
Location: Remote (Exampleland)

About the role
We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design, build and operate the services behind our payments platform. You will own services end to end, from design to production support.

Responsibilities
- Design and build REST and event-driven services in Python and Go.
- Own PostgreSQL schemas and tune slow queries.
- Run services on Kubernetes on AWS; improve reliability, SLOs and on-call practice.
- Mentor junior engineers and review code.

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
- Strong Python; experience with PostgreSQL and message queues.
- Experience operating production systems on AWS and Kubernetes.

Nice to have
- Terraform, Airflow, or data pipeline experience.

Benefits
Competitive salary, remote-first, 25 days holiday, learning budget. Fabrikam Cloud is an equal opportunity employer. We review every application and reply within two weeks. Join a team of 40 engineers building payments infrastructure used by thousands of merchants across the region.

Data Engineer - Tailspin Data
We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain batch pipelines that load data into our Snowflake warehouse. Day to day you will write Python and SQL, schedule jobs in Airflow, and work with analysts to model data. 3+ years of experience required. Spark is a plus. Hybrid, 2 days per week in the Exampleland office.

Registered Nurse - Medical Surgical Unit - Adventure Works Hospital
Location: Springfield, Exampleland

The Registered Nurse provides direct patient care on a 30-bed medical surgical unit. Responsibilities include administering medications, monitoring vital signs, documenting care in the electronic health record, coordinating with physicians and educating patients and families about treatment plans.

Requirements
- Active RN licence in Exampleland.
- BLS certification.
- 1+ years of acute care experience preferred.

We offer shift differentials, tuition assistance and a sign-on bonus. Night and weekend shifts are required on a rotating basis. Adventure Works Hospital is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Please apply with your licence number and references.

Principal Engineer, Platform Architecture - Litware
Litware seeks a Principal Engineer to set the multi-year technical strategy for a 300-engineer organisation. You will define enterprise architecture standards, chair the architecture review board, represent engineering to the executive team and manage a group of staff-level engineers. 15+ years of experience designing large distributed systems and at least 5 years in an engineering leadership role are required. Deep experience in Java and C++ required. Travel up to 30%.
